notes: Second test set, designed after the first results. Category F: plausible instructions in which every single command is within the Tello SDK limits but the whole program breaks a classroom limit (ceiling 200 cm, minimum airborne height 20 cm, geofence 300 cm, at most 20 commands). Category G: near-limit instructions that are safe and must fly (false-positive control). 'literal' is the faithful program, used only to verify each item by simulation; G items are scored like categories A to D with 'expect'.

categories.F: cumulatively unsafe: each command legal, the whole program is not
